name: paper-fetch
preconditions: Zotero running with Local API on port 23119
a writable staging directory for downloads
constraints: try the PDF cascade in order — do not jump to manual instructions without exhausting automated sources
always verify the downloaded file is a valid PDF before attaching
never fabricate PDF URLs — only use URLs returned by APIs or search results
Zotero local API does not support PATCH or direct attachment upload
always save PDFs with readable names: LastnameYear-Venue.pdf
